AE-08 phase 9 integration (hand record, no --bless). Covers d5543700..HEAD of this part: the PARENT-RULING-LATENCY-OWED-ORACLE implementation, the guard tests, the record-seeds fix, and 1844427d.

Ruling implemented: the hook fuzz oracle (tools/acceptance/ae-08-processor-state-fuzz-hook.ts, -hook-waiters.ts, -host.ts) judges an owed latency edit at the first quiescent live point after it became owed (no lost session, started and prepared, no outstanding host reply, no held publication, no pending transition, delivered and current progress, no unsettled waiter or uncompiled compilation) and at the drain, never at a teardown. A teardown carries the debt into the next session, a newer latency edit replaces it, and an undo that leaves desired == native passes. The failure's domain is now live.

Seed table on the final oracle at HEAD: 66, 281, 112, 10, 336, 851, 889 pass; 610, 625, 683, 744, 958 (failing in an earlier oracle iteration) pass. Negative control: on HEAD, disabling the Play-transport fix (lane publication check, 6666fcab Play-wait gate, f973b39d endedByDrop) still passes 66 and 281, because later gating makes the lost edit unreachable there. On a tree archived at f4ffbda2 (tools/acceptance from HEAD) with only the lane check removed, seed 66 and seed 281 fail I1 (native fft 2048, desired 512); with the check kept they pass. 1844427d is still needed: reverting its owner change fails seed 889 (I1) and the C witness 'B6d2 a latency edit whose paused-domain retry a seek cancels reaches native in the seek's domain'.

Guard tests: two DV01 STEP7 tests in native-playback-controller.test.ts (a Play resumes in the prepared epoch and in a new epoch while a burst of schedule adoptions keeps arriving). A mutation of the runAdoption gate does not fail them, so they guard only; no schedule-adoption starvation defect exists. tools/certification/record-seeds.ts no longer refuses to write when summary hashes differ (a diagnostic only, as in FAST-CERT).

Seed records: re-recorded 1000 controller and 1000 hook seeds on the final oracle. Controller unchanged. Hook: only ceilings (compileCount), rejections and exercised moved on 350 fields; no seed fails; compileCount drift is the intended drift already ruled (rejection lists moved on seeds where a latency edit was cancelled in the ending-transport domain). Summary hashes differ on every hook seed and on controller seed 4 (known drift), left for --full; no pinned hash is edited here.

Arm anchors re-pointed to the source as it now stands: rc2:399:0:mutant and diag:385/390-plus-399 (the owner's cancel loop now also takes an admitted execution, from 1844427d) and rc2:historical-75:0:mutant (its first anchor was ambiguous after f973b39d; it now includes the preceding nextPatch line). The mutants are otherwise unchanged. The 4 re-pointed mutants and their controls were re-run and pass.

Previous worker's list: no 'as const' remains in d5543700..HEAD; runAdoption root fix f973b39d present and it removed the 714bf902 Timeline retry; runner temp-dir leaks fixed by 0dfab6b5. Native: protocol 30, ctest 24/24, plug-in-gated host tests pass; artifact id stays daw-audio-host-macos/v10 because the hello handshake and every control frame already carry and check protocolVersion.
